name: SoLa CrossFit

plans.name: 12x Month
plans.note: Twelve classes a month, at all scheduled class times. Includes a goal-setting session at signup and every 90 days. The gym does not publish its commitment terms.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.note: All scheduled class times plus Open Gym, and a goal-setting session at signup and every 90 days.

class_packs.name: 8-class punch card
class_packs.note: Access to all class times, expires 60 days from purchase.

class_packs.name: 4-class punch card
class_packs.note: Access to all class times, expires 30 days from purchase.

class_packs.name: Drop-in
class_packs.note: Single class or open gym session for visiting athletes.

day_pass_terms: Single class or open gym session
day_pass_detail: 8-class punch card $180 — $22.50 a class, against $240 for eight drop-ins, and it expires after 60 days
4-class punch card $100 — $25 a class, against $120 for four drop-ins, and it expires after 30 days
sourcing_notes: The rate card states a single price per tier and names no enrollment or annual fee anywhere on the page. Both are recorded as sourced zeros rather than as unknowns, on the CorePower precedent.

The gym publishes no commitment terms for either monthly plan, so `commit_months` is null and no contract badge renders. It links a membership hold and a cancellation form, which implies cancellation is possible but does not state a minimum term — and silence is not a "no contract" claim.
